answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a cipher-signed identity before it can enter the market, and make each new inlet for work cost a fresh stake. A reef of independent verifiers then samples transactions and slashes stakes tied to duplicate or fake identities. One attacker can still buy a few seats, but cloning thousands of sock-puppets means funding thousands of stakes and losing them all when the reef catches the pattern — the attack cost scales linearly while its payoff stays flat.
